steps: Sign in to the web app.
Click "New chat" in the sidebar (or the same action in the collapsed sidebar rail).
Look at the conversation area: it should show no earlier messages.
Look at the composer at the bottom: it should be ready to type in, with the default model shown.

S12.02.needs: an account with a name set
S12.02.note: The greeting variant is chosen by date and hour (packages/platform/utils/src/greeting.ts), so the exact wording can differ between tries.
steps: Make sure your name is set: Settings > Personalization > "What should AGI call you?" (type a name and save).
Click "Sidebar > New chat".
Read the greeting above the composer.
Compare: it should say a time-of-day greeting with your name, for example "Good morning, <name>" (the wording depends on the time of day and the date).

S12.03.note: The save control's exact label was not confirmed in the code.
steps: Open Settings and choose "Personalization".
Clear the field "What should AGI call you?" (its hint says "Leave empty to skip names.") and save.
Click "Sidebar > New chat".
Compare: the greeting should have no name and no personal details in it.
S12.03.where: Settings > Personalization > "What should AGI call you?"

S12.04.note: No suggested-prompt control was found on the new-chat screen. The only clickable starter prompts found are "Start with one of these" in the first-run wizard (apps/web/features/onboarding/components/StarterPrompts.tsx), which send a chosen prompt to chat.

S12.05.note: No task-category shortcut row (write, research, image) was found on the new-chat screen. The use-case choices in the first-run wizard (apps/web/features/onboarding/lib/use-cases.ts) are a different feature. Searched the chat, onboarding and sidebar folders for the words.

S12.06.note: The project shortcuts are in the sidebar, not on the new-chat screen itself.
steps: Sign in and look at the "Projects" section in the sidebar.
Click a project name to open it, or click "Show more" if more projects are listed.
Hover a project and use its "New chat in project" action to start a chat in that project.
Compare: the recent projects should be listed there, and the action should open the project or start a chat in it.

labels.text: No files in your library yet.

S12.07.note: The library list is not labelled as recent; the code does not confirm it is ordered by recent use.
steps: On the new-chat screen, click the "+" button (labelled "More composer options").
Click "Add from library" to expand the list.
Click a file in the list to attach it.
Compare: the list should show library files, and the attached file should appear in the composer.
S12.07.where: More composer options (+) > Add from library

S12.08.note: Not applicable: S12.08 is not in the plan file (the file goes from S12.07 to S12.09).

S12.09.note: Searched apps/web/features and packages/ui/ui/src for recommended connector or app suggestions and found none. The ledger gives no code location.

S12.10.note: Web search is also described in the code as ambient, so no separate on/off toggle was found.
steps: On the new-chat screen, click the composer and type "/".
Choose "/search" (described as "Search the web").
Type a question and send it.
Compare: the reply should use a web search for that message.

S12.11.note: The row can be disabled for some models (researchDisabled in ChatComposerNew.tsx).
steps: On the new-chat screen, click the "+" button (labelled "More composer options").
Switch on "Deep Research".
Type a question and send it.
Compare: the reply should run as deep research, with research progress shown.

S12.12.needs: an account that can generate images
S12.12.note: The row only appears when the host can generate images. A "/image" slash command also exists (packages/ui/unified-chat/src/lib/slashCommands.ts).
steps: Click the "+" button (labelled "More composer options") on the new-chat screen.
Click "Create image".
Type a picture description and send it.
Compare: the send should generate an image in the reply.

S12.13.needs: an account that can generate video
S12.13.note: The row only appears when the host can generate video.
steps: Click the "+" button (labelled "More composer options") on the new-chat screen.
Click "Create video".
Type a description and send it.
Compare: the send should start a video generation.

S12.14.note: The button only shows when the field is empty and the account can use voice.
steps: On the new-chat screen, leave the composer empty.
Find the voice button at the right end of the composer (its label is "Start voice mode").
Click it.
Compare: the app should enter a spoken (voice-mode) conversation.
S12.14.where: Composer > "Start voice mode" button (at the right end of the empty composer)

S12.15.needs: an account that can use Work
S12.15.note: The switch shows only when the project picker is shown and the account can use Work. Settings > General "New chats start in" also sets the default (Chat or Work).
steps: On the new-chat screen, click "Work" in the Chat | Work switch above the composer.
Type a task and send it.
Compare: the chat should run as an agentic (multi-step, tool-using) task.

S12.16.note: The Code entry is hidden when the "code" feature is disabled for the account.
steps: Sign in and click "Code" in the sidebar.
Look for the coding screen (the page at /code).
Compare: it should offer a coding session tied to a repository or workspace.

S12.17.note: The row only appears when showTemporaryChat is true, which depends on the project and account.
steps: On the new-chat screen, click the "+" button (labelled "More composer options").
Click "Temporary chat".
Type a message and send it.
Compare: the chat should not appear in the sidebar history afterwards.
On the new-chat screen, read the composer footer before sending.
Note the model shown on the model button (by default "Auto (Recommended)").
Click it to open the model list.
Compare: the shown model should be the one the next message uses.

S12.19.needs: an account that is a member of an organization
S12.19.note: The line is hidden when the account has no organization workspace. The English value for the personal workspace was not found in en/common.json; the code default is "Personal" (apps/web/features/chat/components/GreetingBanner/NewChatWorkspace.tsx). Label 2 is the Spanish file, so its path is not the English source.
steps: Sign in to an account that belongs to an organization.
Click "New chat" in the sidebar.
Read the line under the greeting: it shows a building icon and "Workspace: <name>" for an organization, or "Personal" when the personal workspace is active.
Compare with the workspace the chat will be saved into.
S12.19.where: New chat > line under the greeting "Workspace: <name>"

S12.20.note: The picker is provided only by hosts that pass a project picker to the composer.
steps: Click "New chat" in the sidebar.
Click the project picker in the composer (it shows "Project or folder" when Work is available, otherwise "Project").
Pick a project from the list.
Send a message and compare: the new chat should be created in that project.
S12.20.where: New chat > composer project picker ("Project or folder")

S12.21.note: No mode explanation or example text was found in the composer or chat folders. The ledger says live-web.

S12.22.needs: a new account that has not finished onboarding
S12.22.note: Once onboarding is complete, /welcome redirects to /chat.
steps: Create a new account and finish sign-in.
On the welcome page, read "What should we call you?" and click "Continue".
On "What do you want to do first?", look for the "How this works" section.
Click "Finish" or a starter prompt, then compare: the short introduction should cover the key features.

S12.23.note: The draft is stored in apps/web/features/chat/components/Composer/composer-draft-storage.ts; a draft-conflict toast can appear.
steps: On the new-chat screen, type text in the composer but do not send it.
Go to another page in the app, or reload the page.
Return to the new chat.
Compare: the typed text should be back in the composer.

S12.24.note: Guest chat is behind the 'guest.chat' switch (apps/web/lib/guest-chat/config.ts), which the owner has left off. The guest-limit copy ("Without an account you can send ... messages a day.") is in packages/ui/i18n/locales/en/chat.json but no consumer was found in apps/web. No sign-in prompt for guests was found.
